name: CAROL
source:
Disappearance of a huge number of children happened seven years ago.
Main character was among those children. Today he lives peacefully with sister and mother. He moves to the school where his sister studies. What kind of encounters await him there? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
七年前，發生了一起大批兒童失蹤的事件。
主角也是當年失蹤的孩子之一。如今，他與妹妹和母親過著平靜的生活，並轉入妹妹就讀的學校。在那裡，會有什麼樣的邂逅等待著他？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
